Copy the bundled example setup

Source: R/lerwq_example.R
lerwq_example.Rd

Copies the example setup shipped with the package to a folder of your choice, so it can be configured and run without modifying the installed package. The example covers one year (1995) of Lake Mendota (Wisconsin, USA): meteorological forcing, inflow/outflow, bathymetry, observed water temperature and water quality, and LakeEnsemblR/LakeEnsemblR.WQ configuration files for GLM-AED, GOTM-WET, GOTM-Selmaprotbas and Simstrat-AED2. It is used by the examples throughout this package.

Usage

lerwq_example(dest = file.path(tempdir(), "lerwq_example"), overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

dest

character; folder to copy the example into. Created if it does not exist. Defaults to a folder in tempdir().

overwrite

logical; overwrite files that already exist in dest.

Value

The normalized path to dest.

Examples

ex <- lerwq_example()
list.files(ex)
#>  [1] "LakeEnsemblR.yaml"                      
#>  [2] "LakeEnsemblR_WQ.yaml"                   
#>  [3] "LakeEnsemblR_bathymetry_standard.csv"   
#>  [4] "LakeEnsemblR_ice-height_standard.csv"   
#>  [5] "LakeEnsemblR_inflow_standard.csv"       
#>  [6] "LakeEnsemblR_meteo_standard_daily.csv"  
#>  [7] "LakeEnsemblR_outflow_standard.csv"      
#>  [8] "LakeEnsemblR_wtemp_profile_standard.csv"
#>  [9] "Output.yaml"                            
#> [10] "WQ_input_files"                         
#> [11] "calibration"                            
#> [12] "standart_observed_data.csv"
